The background is a simple white wall with a floral painting. (2) The camera moves closer as he pinches his cheeks and midsection, demonstrating areas of concern regarding body fat. (3) He is then shown sitting in a modern, brightly lit office across from a female consultant who holds a document. (4) A brief shot of the clinic's reception area and sign 'JB Jolie Bellezza' (妍之漾時尚診所) is visible. (5) The man consults with a male doctor in a white coat who explains a procedure using hand gestures. (6) A technical montage begins with a staff member applying cleaning foam to the man's face while he lies down. (9) The creator walks through the clinic, showing off a luxurious lounge with a curved sofa and a gallery-style hallway with various digital artworks. (10) The video ends with the man posing happily in front of the clinic's logo wall.

A male voice speaks with high arousal and a comedic, aggressive tone, addressing the 'unwanted fat' as if it were a person. (2) A sharp 'whoosh' transition SFX marks a shift. The male voice becomes more conversational, explaining his motivation for seeking treatment. (3) A 'pop' SFX triggers during a graphic transition. A female voice provides a brief, professional response to a question. (4) Another 'whoosh' SFX leads to a professional male voice (the doctor), who speaks with calm authority and moderate speed, explaining technical details. (5) A series of 'pop' and 'cartoon' SFX accent the visual montage of the cleaning and medical procedure. The BGM remains consistent and upbeat. (6) A 'ding' bell SFX highlights the before-and-after results being discussed. The primary male voice returns with high arousal and joyful inflection. (7) Final 'whoosh' and rhythmic music swell as the male voice provides a final, high-energy recommendation before the track fades out.
